in_sanskrit.name: वसुन्धरा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The goddess of wealth, abundance, and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is often depicted as a beautiful woman with an elephant as her mount. The name Vasundhara is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vasu', meaning wealth, and 'dhara', meaning holder or supporter.

in_hindi.name: वसुन्धरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Vasundhara in Hindi translates to 'wealthy' or 'rich'. In Hindu mythology, Vasundhara is the goddess of wealth and abundance, often depicted as a beautiful woman with an elephant as her mount.

in_tamil.name: வசுந்தரா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Vasundhara translates to 'abundant' or 'wealthy'. In Hindu mythology, Vasundhara is the goddess of wealth and abundance, often depicted as a beautiful woman with an elephant as her mount.

in_telugu.name: వశుద్హరా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Vasundhara translates to 'Goddess of wealth' or 'Wealthy one'. In Hindu mythology, Vasundhara is the goddess of wealth and abundance, often depicted as a beautiful woman with an elephant as her mount.

in_marathi.name: Vasundhara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth, abundance, and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasundhara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of wealth, abundance, prosperity, and fertility. She is believed to bestow material and spiritual wealth upon her devotees. In Hindu mythology, Vasundhara is depicted as the queen of the earth, sitting on a lotus, surrounded by seven rivers and holding a golden lotus in her hand.
